notes: DATE CORRECTION vs task input: the official page prints 'June 25, 2025' - NOT 2025-12-23 (the OpenRouter listing timestamp probably reflects a later Seed1.6 update/variant listing; official page date is authoritative and recorded here). JS-rendered model page (web reader returns nav shell; headless browser extraction used). No machine-readable benchmark values: the page references an LLM evaluation table for Seed1.6 Base whose values render in a non-DOM component, and external-model performance is disclosed as 'sourced from the Qwen Technical Report' - so even the table's comparison columns are second-hand. Qualitative claims only: 'matched or even outperformed Seed1.5-VL in multiple visual tasks' and 'high scores in generalization tests such as college entrance exams in China and abroad'. Training disclosure: three-stage continual pretraining (text-only -> multimodal mixed MMCT -> long-context LongCT 32K->256K); AdaCoT (Adaptive Chain-of-Thought) initiates thinking based on question difficulty for effectiveness/latency trade-off. GUI-based interaction and deep reasoning listed as capabilities; served via Volcano Engine API. No benchmark_evidence rows extractable this pass - the release stays pending with the table image documented here as the upgrade path (transcribe the Base LLM eval table from the rendered component). 2026-09-01 audit UPGRADE: the previously non-DOM evaluation table was captured by the archiver as images/05.jpg; all 8 rows of the Seed1.6 Base column transcribed (MMLU 88.83, MMLU-Pro 69.98, SuperGPQA 45.08, BBH 92.08, GPQA-Diamond 43.43, GSM8k 93.10, MATH 72.86, MBPP 83.60) with model_variant=Base. Images 03.png/04.jpg are decorative hero art; 02.png is the page banner - no other numeric content on the page. The instruct/multimodal Seed1.6 flagship itself still has no published numeric scores on this page; qualitative claims stand as noted above.
